note_path: The protocol names results/v2_selection.json; v2 outputs live under results/v2/, so the selection record is results/v2/v2_selection.json.

rule.tie: accepted candidates within 0.01 kappa of the best -> fewest of {ensemble, smoothing, extra features, class weighting}; then higher kappa
rule.multiclass: the chosen spec is also the 3- and 4-class model (no separate choice)

rule.metric: cross_dataset.mean.kappa_pooled (minute kappa; fold A apnea-ecg -> slpdb, fold B slpdb -> apnea-ecg)
rule.tie: within 0.01 kappa -> fewest of {ensemble, class weighting, extra features, slpdb in training}
rule.note: Cross-dataset folds do not depend on train_on (each side is one database), so candidates differing only in train_on tie there; train_on is read from subject_cv_union.

skipped.candidate: 1. More CAP training records (remaining non-NFLE and NFLE records)
skipped.reason: Extra CAP records were not available (no features or RR cache for them) when the grid was run; per the task it is skipped, not scored. If it becomes available it is judged on fold A only (protocol clarification) and combined with the chosen candidate.
The protocol's smoothing candidate is an HMM over sleep stages; the apnea grid in scripts/v2_select_apnea.py has no smoothing option, so none was added.

skipped.candidate: 5. Threshold rules other than the v1 rule
skipped.reason: Only class weighting varies; every binary threshold uses v1's rule (max kappa on a 0.05-0.95 grid of out-of-fold training predictions, nested inside each training side). No alternative threshold rules are in the protocol list.
